outcome: expression of IFN activation signaling pathway molecules (cGAS, STING, IRF3, TLR7, MAVS, IFNb) in placental tissue
placental pathology characteristics (maternal and fetal vascular malperfusion, chronic inflammation)
cohort: The study participants consisted of 20 placentas, 12 from women infected with COVID-19 during pregnancy and 8 from non-COVID-19 controls.
finding: COVID-exposed placentas showed upregulation of IFN activation pathway molecules (STING, IRF3, TLR7, MAVS) with distinct cell-type specific distribution, and main pathological characteristics including maternal and fetal vascular malperfusion and chronic inflammation.
birth_weight: Newborn weight was measured and found not statistically different between groups.
gest_age: Gestational age at delivery was measured and found not statistically different between groups.
